title: Why Timing Matters in Debate
text:
A debate team usually has a clear plan before the first speech begins. This plan, called an outline, lists the main arguments and the order in which they will be presented. Many coaches recommend keeping each argument short so that the audience can follow the logic. Good speakers also prepare a few examples to support each point.

Timing is just as important as content during a debate. Speakers who run out of time often leave their strongest argument unfinished. For this reason, students practice their speeches with a timer and mark key moments on their notes. A well-timed outline helps a team stay calm and confident under pressure.

questions.text: What does the outline list, according to the first paragraph?
options: The main arguments and the order of presenting them
The names of the audience members
The final score of the debate
The words the judges will use

questions.text: What do students do to manage their time, according to the second paragraph?
options: They speak for as long as they like
They practice with a timer and mark key moments
They read the whole speech from a page

questions.text: Why might a speaker who runs out of time lose points?
options: Their strongest argument may never be heard
The judges will ask them to repeat the topic
They will have fewer examples in the outline
The audience will leave the room early

questions.text: What can be inferred about a team with a well-timed outline?
options: They are likely to feel more relaxed under pressure
They never need to take notes
They prefer to speak without any preparation
They are certain to win every debate

vocabulary.definition: a plan showing the main points of something
reasons given to support an opinion
a device that measures a set period of time

paragraph_translations: Команда з дебатів зазвичай має чіткий план ще до початку першої промови. Цей план, який називається структурою, перелічує основні аргументи та порядок, у якому їх буде подано. Багато тренерів радять робити кожен аргумент коротким, щоб слухачі могли стежити за логікою. Гарні промовці також готують кілька прикладів для підтримки кожної тези.

Час має не менше значення, ніж зміст, під час дебатів. Промовці, які не встигають у відведений час, часто залишають свій найсильніший аргумент недоговореним. Тому учні тренують свої промови з таймером і позначають ключові моменти у нотатках. Добре розрахована структура допомагає команді зберігати спокій і впевненість під тиском.
